auth.signInSub: Sign in to apply, post jobs and manage your contracts.
auth.codeSub: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Beleqet.

auth.checkEmailSub1: Your account is ready. We sent a verification link to
auth.checkEmailSub2: Open it to confirm your address.

auth.resetSentSub2: , you’ll get a link to set a new password in a few minutes. The link works for 1 hour.

auth.verifiedSub: Thanks. Your email address is confirmed.
auth.errCredentials: That email and password don’t match. Check them and try again.

escrow.title: Money moves only when the work does.
escrow.sub: Clients fund the contract up front, so freelancers can start knowing the money is there. Each milestone is paid out only after the client approves the work.

step1.title: Fund
step1.text: The client pays the agreed amount into escrow.

step2.title: Deliver
step2.text: The freelancer submits work for each milestone.

step3.title: Approve
step3.text: The client approves the work or asks for changes.

step4.title: Get paid
step4.text: Funds reach the freelancer’s wallet after a 3-day hold.

escrow.termsSub: Everything you pay and every safeguard you get.

fee.v: 10% of each milestone, taken from the freelancer’s payout

client.v: The agreed contract amount, nothing more

timing.v: After client approval, plus a 3-day hold

disputes.v: Either side can open one. Escrow is frozen until Beleqet reviews the case.
